# NearestPoint

<!-- gen:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by `npm run generate:op-docs` from noodles-validate/registry.json. The title and the text between gen:begin and gen:end markers are replaced on every run; write anywhere else. -->

Find the nearest point in a collection to a target point.
<!-- gen:end summary -->

## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->
```json
{
  "id": "/nearest-point",
  "type": "NearestPointOp",
  "position": { "x": 0, "y": 0 },
  "data": { "inputs": {} }
}
```

Expressions and code read its fields as `op('/nearest-point').par.targetPoint` (an input) and `op('/nearest-point').out.nearest` (an output). Edges name the same fields as handles: `par.targetPoint`, `out.nearest`.
<!-- gen:end syntax -->

## Inputs

<!-- gen:begin inputs -->
| Name | Type | Default |
|------|------|---------|
| `targetPoint` | `Point2DField` | `[0,0]` |
| `points` | `GeoJsonField` | `{"type":"FeatureCollection","features":[]}` |
<!-- gen:end inputs -->

## Outputs

<!-- gen:begin outputs -->
| Name | Type |
|------|------|
| `nearest` | `GeoJsonField` |
| `distance` | `NumberField` |
<!-- gen:end outputs -->
